U-235' (h3 33:38-33:47); cliffhanger 'tunggu malam, gue udah boleh tidur berarti?' (h3 33:56-33:58). Word timings from short-window faster-whisper medium (VAD on, and off for silent stretches). Viewer names, platform and brand names are not in any cut. CUT: h2 51:36-51:47 and 51:52-51:57 (a platform name and the Bigfoot name), the swears at h3 34:22/34:35, every spoken viewer name and 'youtube' (h3 32:45 is before the first cut). The phone shows only a generic 'Unknown' thread, no app name. No guns, gore or revealing outfits in frame. Main 42.70 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first).
